subject.title: fix(feishu): route chat tools through contextual accounts

question: Should `feishu_chat` use the shared Feishu contextual account resolver, including fail-closed behavior when the selected contextual account has chat disabled?
rationale: The patch is the clean narrow fix, but it intentionally changes fallback behavior on a credential and tenant boundary that can stop setups relying on the old accidental first-account/default-account route.

options.title: Accept shared resolver precedence
options.body: Merge after relevant checks finish, accepting fail-closed contextual account behavior as the correct Feishu chat security posture.

options.title: Require compatibility default
options.body: Ask for a default-preserving mode or migration note if maintainers want old first-account fallback preserved for existing setups.

options.title: Fold into broader binding work
options.body: Pause this PR and handle chat together with the broader non-inbound Feishu binding/account precedence issue.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver precedence
recommendation.body: Merge after relevant checks finish, accepting fail-closed contextual account behavior as the correct Feishu chat security posture.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows the most repeated work on Feishu account-aware routing and plugin-boundary changes, making this the best available owner for the precedence choice.
